title: Ginger Tofu Rice Bowls
description: Golden tofu and tender-crisp veggies meet a ginger-soy glaze over jasmine rice.
ingredients: 14 oz firm tofu, drained and cubed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Mix soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, cornstarch and water in a bowl.
Pat tofu dry. Heat half the oil in a skillet and cook tofu 6–8 minutes, turning until browned; set aside.
Cook pepper and broccoli in remaining oil for 5–6 minutes.
Return tofu to the skillet, pour in sauce and stir for 1–2 minutes until slightly thickened. Spoon over rice.
